environment: Windows Unity 6000.6.7f1 Editor Mono, headless fresh processes. No player, contention, ARM, or native allocation-byte qualification.

preregistration.baseline: Existing PR clock conversion and pixel readers, with an ignored internal optional flag only for compiling the frozen view controls.
preregistration.candidate: Shared SecondsSince helper and synchronous texture views for masks and bounds; ink keeps owned snapshots.
preregistration.controls: No control workload may regress above 1.10 in two or more pairs. Publish all observations, including individual subject regressions.
preregistration.boundsGate: Across all 3 pairs and 3 actual-sprite patterns, geometric candidate/baseline ratio <= 0.95. Mask-overload patterns and all 4 ink patterns are controls.
preregistration.poolHelperGate: Across all 3 pairs and 4 shared paths, geometric candidate/baseline ratio <=1.05. This is reuse, not an extra speedup claim. Stack, Local and LocalLease are controls.
preregistration.allocationGate: All seven selected readable formats require a positive owned-array event control and no pixel-array events in the borrowed path. No byte or IL2CPP allocation claim.

functionalQualification.nativeResult: Final runtime 626 passed/four existing skips of 630, including all 43 view controls; separate Build Profile fixture passes 23/23.
functionalQualification.ownedArrayControl: 16 allocation events per 16 reads for every format at source sizes 8 and 32 (selected rectangles 6x6 and 30x30).
functionalQualification.textureView: Zero events in each corresponding view read. This is event evidence, not allocated-byte measurement.
functionalQualification.reentrancy: A real dictionary-pool purge callback changed a texture during ink traversal. Borrowing returned the changed center; the retained implementation uses an owned ink snapshot and passes the regression.
functionalQualification.scope: Runtime production source bytes remain equal to the candidate timing inputs. Later test-case additions have separate final native validation.
